name: 鷺

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, the whole figure from the top of the head to the boot soles inside the frame with empty margin. Pose: a natural relaxed walk, mid-stride with a moderate step, upright relaxed torso with a neutral straight back, head level; near leg forward and far leg back, both legs and both feet clearly separated with a gap between the thighs; the near arm swings slightly behind the torso and the far arm slightly forward, both hands relaxed and clearly separated from the body. Believable adult anatomy, exactly two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand. Even soft light from the upper left, no bloom, no glow halo, no weapon in the hands, no extra objects, no text. A 46-year-old veteran harbor mercenary woman, unmistakably female: a mature feminine face with soft cheek and lips, a strong but womanly jaw, visible bust and a defined waist under her clothes; tall and lean with long legs like a heron, athletic shoulders, weathered tan skin, a confident crooked grin and laugh lines, a thin old scar across the cheekbone. Short swept-back steel-grey hair with a white streak, shaved on the sides. She wears a worn slate-grey waterproof storm coat cut short at the hip, properly worn on both shoulders with the collar up and the sleeves on both arms down to the wrists, front open, lined with pale heron-feather-white fabric; a dark tactical harness and rolled sleeves cuffs with brass snaps; a faded orange life-vest collar strap as an accent; charcoal cargo trousers tucked into tall dark rubber harbor boots with pale soles; fingerless gloves. A folded black tactical umbrella is strapped diagonally across her back like a sheathed weapon. Thin teal neon piping along the coat seams.
